GmoneyDT is a Mexican-American rapper from Los Angeles, California, known for his gritty West Coast sound, raw storytelling, and energetic delivery. Born Angel Jimenez, he began making music as a teenager and started gaining attention with his breakout track “Deep End.” His projects Problem Child, Grimey Loc Risk Taker, and Rich Felon helped establish him as one of the emerging artists in LA’s underground rap scene.

GmoneyDT has also built connections throughout the West Coast music scene, including with Ralfy The Plug’s Stinc Team, which he joined on tour in 2024. He has continued releasing music independently, including his 2026 projects Bein Me Ain’t Ez and RICH PAID & GRIMEY. Beyond music, he has been expanding his presence through interviews, social media, and YouTube content. He is also scheduled to perform alongside OhGeesy, Mike Sherm, 03 Greedo, and several other West Coast artists at the “Who Want The Smoke” Festival in San Diego on November 13, 2026.
